subject: Variability framework — mandatory pre-flight checklist for all question generation
body: GR — FR completed a full structural audit of RP1-RP7. Average QDS: 0.13, target 0.45. Nine of eleven concepts critical. Key issues: (1) Q3 absolute value always negative orientation — Kai has never seen upward-opening. (2) Q5 quadratic always vertex form — never standard form. (3) Q15 word problem gives pre-built formula in 6 of 7 practices — Kai never writes the model himself. (4) RP6-Q7 is identical to RP1-Q6 — exact same equation, must be replaced. Immediate fixes before Kai takes RP4-7: strip formula from Q15, add text input for model. Fix RP6-Q7 duplicate. Add one L3 construct question per practice from RP5 forward. Introduce standard form quadratic in at least one Q1 slot by RP5. Full pre-flight checklist and variant library at: C:\GitHub\kai-algebra2-tests\docs\fr-variability-framework.md. FR audits 1-in-3 questions per practice from now on.
